summary.title: Dropped Sexton so Sheppard (healthy) leaves IL; Wed lineup set
summary.headline: Done and verified on Yahoo 07:19 ET: Sexton dropped, Sheppard IL -> BN; Wed: Sheppard starts SG for idle Podziemski.
summary.verdict: Sheppard's back tag cleared, so he could not stay in IL legally and blocked every add. Of the possible drops, Sexton costs least: +0.85 ± 0.24 pp P(playoffs) vs ~-0.8 pp for dropping Sheppard.
risks: Sexton (LAL) has 3 games left this week vs Sheppard's 2 (HOU); he was mostly benched anyway.
Season deltas assume the sim's roster-cap rule (it planned to cut Sexton ~11-25 when Leonard returns anyway).
Sexton goes to waivers; a rival could claim him (10% rostered).
rationale: - 14 healthy players for 13 active+bench spots once Sheppard's Q cleared; lineup tool could not plan and Yahoo blocks adds (#845).
- Paired season sims (season-sim-0.8.1, 4000 sims, same seed): drop Sexton +0.85 ± 0.24 pp, Sheppard -0.75 ± 0.33, Champagnie -2.3 ± 0.34.
- No NBA games today (Election Day), so no lock/#174 risk.
- After the drop, no free agent helps (stream + opportunity: all 'hurts').

why_now.before: 11-02: kept everyone; Sheppard (Q) sat in IL and dropping him was rated -1 pp (hurts). The roster cap was going to force a cut when Leonard returns (~11-23).

changed.text: Yahoo cleared Sheppard's Q tag on 11-02 evening, so he is healthy in IL: roster over the 13-spot limit and adds blocked.
No games today: the cheapest moment to make the forced drop.
